action_item_for_main_agent: CRITICAL: Fix Kubernetes ingress timeout issue. Current timeout is 60 seconds but /api/generate and /api/assemble endpoints need 90-180 seconds to complete due to LLM processing time. Recommended solutions: (1) Increase ingress timeout annotation to 180s, OR (2) Implement async job pattern with polling endpoint. Without this fix, the core generation features (AI Mode and Form Mode) are non-functional in production. Note: /api/fill-form works fine (completes within 60s), so the issue is specifically with the longer generate/assemble operations.
